monsters.name: Giant Rat

monsters.summary: Night flier; navigates by sonar.

monsters.name: Hawk
monsters.summary: Small raptor.

monsters.name: Owl
monsters.summary: Nocturnal raptor.

monsters.name: Raven
monsters.summary: Clever corvid.

monsters.name: Badger
monsters.summary: Burrowing omnivore with a thick hide.

monsters.name: Fox
monsters.summary: Small, quick canid.

monsters.name: Otter
monsters.summary: River mustelid.

monsters.name: Sheep
monsters.summary: Grazing flock animal; charges when threatened.

monsters.name: Viper
monsters.feat: Heat vision (special) senses.
monsters.summary: Venomous snake.

monsters.name: Black Bear
monsters.summary: Forest bear; aggressive when provoked.

monsters.name: Cheetah
monsters.summary: Fastest runner of the plains.

monsters.name: Deer
monsters.summary: Timid grazer; bolts when startled.

monsters.name: Donkey / Mule
monsters.summary: Pack animal.

monsters.name: Goat
monsters.summary: Hardy climber; butts with its horns.

monsters.name: Seal
monsters.summary: Coastal swimmer.

monsters.name: Leopard
monsters.summary: Solitary big cat; ambush hunter.

monsters.name: Wolf / Mastiff
monsters.summary: Pack hunter.

monsters.name: Dire Wolf
monsters.summary: Huge wolf that hunts in packs.

monsters.name: War Horse
monsters.feat: Trample: passes through medium or smaller creatures when it dashes, dealing 1d6 blunt damage to each that doesn't save vs. Blast.
monsters.summary: Trained battle mount.

monsters.name: Ox
monsters.feat: Trample: as the War Horse.
monsters.summary: Draft beast; slow to anger.

monsters.name: Boar
monsters.summary: Tusked forest pig; charges.

monsters.name: Cattle
monsters.feat: Trample: passes through medium or smaller creatures when it dashes, dealing 1d6 blunt damage to each that doesn't save vs. Blast.
monsters.summary: Herd animal.

monsters.name: Dolphin
monsters.feat: Sonar.
monsters.summary: Intelligent sea mammal.

monsters.name: Draft Horse
monsters.feat: Trample: as the War Horse.
monsters.summary: Heavy working horse.

monsters.name: Elk
monsters.feat: Trample: as the War Horse.
monsters.summary: Antlered forest grazer.

monsters.name: Shark
monsters.feat: Frenzy: adds +2d6 damage to an attack if the target is injured.
monsters.summary: Predatory fish.

monsters.name: Orca
monsters.feat: Sonar.
monsters.summary: Pod-hunting dolphin of the deep.

monsters.name: Barrow-Cat
monsters.feat: Can turn invisible until it attacks; may cast a major illusion of itself up to 5 paces away.
monsters.summary: Large grinning cat with prehensile whisker-tendrils.

monsters.name: Keryne
monsters.feat: Can cast beguile or fey illusion to lure mortals.
monsters.summary: Snow-white hunthind with golden antlers.

monsters.name: Chuckboe
monsters.summary: Flightless predatory bird; raised as a mount.

monsters.name: Omencrow
monsters.feat: Casts as a druid and can cast mage hand.
monsters.summary: Sapient, speech-capable crow.

monsters.name: Firefox
monsters.feat: Casts as a druid.
monsters.summary: Fox with a glowing, fanning tail.

monsters.name: Dire Vole
monsters.feat: Digs through solid earth at full dash speed, then leaps out to sneak attack.
monsters.summary: Cat-sized vole with lightning reflexes.

monsters.name: Phoenix
monsters.feat: Casts any Flame-based primal glamour; once per day, a primal revive.
monsters.summary: Fiery raptor with a peacock's tail.

monsters.name: Frostfang
monsters.feat: Can cast call storm or the cone of cold spell.
monsters.summary: Enormous white direwolf of winter.

monsters.name: Roc
monsters.feat: Can lift and carry up to 4 tons.
monsters.summary: Giant eagle the size of a horse.

monsters.name: Thunderbird
monsters.feat: Casts any Air-aspected primal glamour.
monsters.summary: Storm-cloud eagle.

monsters.name: Landshark
monsters.feat: Digs through solid earth at full dash speed, then leaps out with a 10-foot sneak attack.
monsters.summary: Ox-sized fairy armadillo; always aggressive.

monsters.name: Kelpie
monsters.feat: Casts beguile, fey illusion, mirage, and tidal wave glamours.
monsters.summary: River-otter that drowns mortals it lures into water.

monsters.name: Hippogryph
monsters.feat: Gains +2d6 damage to each attack when injured.
monsters.summary: Horse-bodied griffon with a kite's head.

monsters.name: Leogryph
monsters.feat: Gains +2d6 damage to each attack when injured.
monsters.summary: Lion-bodied griffon with an eagle's head.

monsters.name: Ursagryph
monsters.feat: Gains +2d6 damage to each attack when injured.
monsters.summary: Bear-bodied griffon; a slow, silent flier.

monsters.name: Nightmare
monsters.feat: Casts beguile, fey illusion, or sleep glamours, and cause fear. Senses fear.
monsters.summary: Starved black warhorse with vulture wings.

monsters.name: Pegasus
monsters.feat: Can spend 1 glamour to fly up to 160 paces.
monsters.summary: White winged warhorse.

monsters.name: Unicorn
monsters.feat: Casts sanctuary and cure critical wounds miracles. Intelligent.
monsters.summary: Intelligent horned horse; often speaks.

monsters.name: Rustgrub
monsters.feat: Rust metal; spits corrosive saliva (2 glamour). Yields water and stone materia.
monsters.summary: Metal-eating larva of the rust hulk.

monsters.name: Bloodstirge
monsters.feat: Drains Constitution each round until it's knocked off; can carry disease.
monsters.summary: Giant mosquito that drains blood in swarms.

monsters.name: Fire Beetle
monsters.feat: Flamethrower: 3 glamour for a 4-pace cone of flame, 2d6 fire damage. Yields flame materia.
monsters.summary: Glowing beetle that sprays flammable acid.

monsters.name: Cave Spider
monsters.feat: Ensnaring web; poison bite; web tremors sense creatures near its lair.
monsters.summary: Overgrown faerie spider; webs cover its lair.

monsters.name: Gelatinous Ooze
monsters.feat: Paralyzing mucus; digestion heals it; splits when cut below half hit points.
monsters.summary: Mindless, transparent slime that engulfs and digests.

monsters.name: Rust Hulk
monsters.feat: Hard shell; frenzy when damaged. Yields stone materia.
monsters.summary: Beetle-gorilla that eats metal.

monsters.name: Mimic
monsters.feat: Crushing hug (1d6 bashing per round); poison bite; camouflage as treasure. Yields fey or dream materia.
monsters.summary: Shapeshifting cephalopod that poses as loot.

monsters.name: Roper
monsters.feat: Hard shell; paralyzing bite; nest of 1d6+1 piercers on the ceiling. Yields stone materia.
monsters.summary: Stalagmite-like mollusc that drops on prey.

monsters.name: Wisp
monsters.feat: Primal magic: a first-circle glamour of its element. Regenerates at sunrise or sunset. Can serve a druid as a familiar.
monsters.summary: Elemental bundle of materia; nearly indestructible.

monsters.name: Pixie
monsters.attacks: ranged 2d6 psychic, aetheric, or elemental (5 paces)
monsters.feat: Casts primal magic as a druid.
monsters.summary: Tiny fey wellspring of primal magic.

monsters.name: Goodfellow
monsters.feat: Casts primal magic as a druid. Can seal a promise as a sworn geas for 3 glamour.
monsters.summary: Fair Folk posing as a traveler; trades aid for secrecy.

monsters.name: Boggle
monsters.feat: Shapeshifts to mimic any creature it has observed closely (3 glamour).
monsters.summary: Grey goblin-faced shapechanger.

monsters.name: Thyrs
monsters.attacks: per wielded weapon (weapon attacks deal 2x damage)
monsters.feat: Regenerates by spending glamour; turned to stone in sunlight.
monsters.summary: Stone troll of barbarian tribes.

monsters.name: Hag
monsters.attacks: Evil Eye (10-pace ranged attack, 2d6 psychic stunning)
monsters.feat: Casts primal magic as a druid. Illusions and enslaved goblin-orc tribes.
monsters.summary: Fear-of-strangers nightmare in an old woman's guise.

monsters.name: Oreiad
monsters.feat: Casts Stone- or Fey-aspected glamours. Regenerates on natural stone.
monsters.summary: Stone nymph bound to a boulder or vein.

monsters.name: Naiad
monsters.feat: Casts Water- or Fey-aspected glamours. Regenerates in its waters.
monsters.summary: Water nymph bound to a river or lake.

monsters.name: Dryad
monsters.feat: Casts Wood- or Fey-aspected glamours. Regenerates near its tree.
monsters.summary: Tree nymph; protects its grove.

monsters.name: Auriad
monsters.feat: Casts Air- or Fey-aspected glamours. Regenerates flying under open sky.
monsters.summary: Wind nymph that never binds to matter.

monsters.name: Hestaiad
monsters.feat: Casts Flame- or Fey-aspected glamours. Regenerates within its hearth.
monsters.summary: Hearth-flame nymph; wild ones consume what they touch.

monsters.name: Leannán-Sí
monsters.feat: Casts primal glamours; drains a willing mortal's years to regain glamour.
monsters.summary: Seductive fey who trades love for vitality.

monsters.name: Horned Hunter
monsters.attacks: Legendary Aetheric Blade (1d6+Str+4 piercing sneak attack); Legendary Windbow (2d6+4 piercing and poison sneak attack)
monsters.feat: Casts primal glamours; Wild Hunt marks a quarry it always finds.
monsters.summary: Antlered forest hunter with a spectral hound pack.

monsters.name: Cockatrice
monsters.feat: Petrify: 3d6 stunning gaze in a 10-pace cone.
monsters.summary: Degenerate dragon; its gaze turns flesh to stone.

monsters.name: Basilisk
monsters.attacks: bite (1D6+5 piercing structural), claws (1D6+5 slashing structural), tail bash (2D6 bashing structural)
monsters.feat: Petrify: 8 ichor for a 3d6 stunning gaze in a 10-pace cone.
monsters.summary: Six-legged crocodile-dragon with a petrifying gaze.

monsters.name: Celestial Dragon
monsters.attacks: bite (1D6 piercing structural), claws (1D6 sundering structural), tail bash (1D6+4 blunt structural)
monsters.feat: 9 ichor: glamours, breath attack (2D6 structural elemental, 30-pace cone), focused breath (60-pace line).
monsters.summary: Metallic-scaled, made dragon; often a local god.

monsters.name: Primordial Wyrmling
monsters.attacks: bite (1D6+1 piercing structural), claws (1D6+1 sundering structural), wing buffet (5d6 thunder), tail bash (1D6+5 blunt structural)
monsters.feat: 10 ichor: elemental glamours and breath attacks; halves damage of its own element.
monsters.summary: Adult primordial dragon in the making; ravenous for metal.

monsters.name: Shade
monsters.summary: Echo of a passion, repeating a fixed routine.

monsters.name: Wraith
monsters.abilities: Dex *, Int +0, Wis *, Cha *; talents any it had in life
monsters.feat: Has dark faith equal to its level for death-domain curses.
monsters.summary: Spirit of a mortal who kept their identity.

monsters.name: Skeleton
monsters.feat: Half damage from piercing; double from blunt; instantly slain by divine attacks that deal hit point damage.
monsters.summary: Animated bones; a mindless wight.

monsters.name: Shambler
monsters.attacks: unarmed strike (d6+2 bashing), grapple, bite (d6 piercing)
monsters.feat: Half damage from piercing; always slow; infectious (plague).
monsters.summary: Plague-bearing corpse; can't dash or react.

monsters.name: Revenant
monsters.attacks: as mortal; bite (1d6+1 stunning necrotic) on a restrained or grappled creature
monsters.abilities: Con +2, Str +2, Dex +0, Int +0, Wis +0, Cha +0; talents any it had in life
monsters.feat: Dark faith equal to its level; raises shamblers and skeletons; each 10 hit points it inflicts heals 1d6+2.
monsters.summary: Intelligent undead born of a curse or a botched revival.

monsters.name: Vampire
monsters.attacks: as mortal (x2); bite (1d6 piercing) on a restrained or grappled creature
monsters.abilities: Con +2, Str +2, Dex +2, Int +2, Wis +2, Cha +2; talents any it had in life
monsters.feat: Spends blood for extra actions, damage, and dark miracles; thralls; immune to poison and disease; rises again unless staked.
monsters.summary: Apex blood-drinking undead that makes thralls.

monsters.name: Lich
monsters.attacks: as a mortal, plus any prepared spells or cantrips (x2)
monsters.abilities: Con +4, Str +0, Dex +0, Int +5, Wis +5, Cha +5; talents all
monsters.feat: 10 dark faith: death-domain miracles; arcane spells as a fifth-level wizard; raises undead without limit; regenerates from its animating relic.
monsters.summary: Undead sorcerer-priest bound to a relic.

monsters.name: Jabal
monsters.attacks: large weapon (2x damage); may cast flesh to stone at will
monsters.feat: Djinn magic: Stone- or Fey-aspected glamours. Conjures treasure once a day.
monsters.summary: Earth djinn; conjures wealth and palaces.

monsters.name: Marid
monsters.feat: Djinn magic: Water- or Fey-aspected glamours. Inspires Finesse, Charm, or Bearing rolls.
monsters.summary: Water djinn that counsels its masters toward ruin.

monsters.name: Sila
monsters.attacks: any weapon; may cast beguile at will
monsters.feat: Djinn magic: Wood- or Fey-aspected glamours. Perfect Lover makes beguiling easier.
monsters.summary: Wood djinn of lust and indulgence.

monsters.name: Jatham
monsters.feat: Djinn magic: Air- or Fey-aspected glamours. Sage Counsel makes knowledge rolls easier.
monsters.summary: Air djinn of intrigue, travel, and visions.

monsters.name: Ifrit
monsters.attacks: large weapon (2x damage); elemental grasp and elemental dart (flame) at will
monsters.feat: Djinn magic: Flame- or Fey-aspected glamours. Spur to Glory eases combat rolls while it maintains focus.
monsters.summary: Fire djinn of war and conquest.

monsters.name: Shedim
monsters.feat: Possesses a human host, adding its hit dice and abilities. Three favor: life- or death-aspected dark miracles, possession.
monsters.summary: Possessing demon that waits for a weak-willed host.

monsters.name: Imp
monsters.feat: Two favor: dark miracles; disappears into the Shadow. Immune to poison and critical hits.
monsters.summary: Tiny summoned demon that whispers to its summoner.

monsters.name: Hellhound
monsters.feat: Five favor: war- or death-aspected dark miracles; tracks prey.
monsters.summary: Black, red-eyed dire wolf that guards infernal cults.

monsters.name: Lilin
monsters.feat: Seven favor: beauty, freedom, or fate dark miracles; shapeshifts; succubus kiss (2d6 necrotic).
monsters.summary: Demon of lust who breeds half-infernal children.

monsters.name: Baal-malak
monsters.attacks: longsword (1D6+5 fire structure), whip (1D6 lightning structure) x2
monsters.feat: Ten favor: fate, war, or death dark miracles; smite (+5d6). Accompanied by 2d20 warlock cultists.
monsters.summary: Duke of Hell that needs a sacrificing cult to manifest.

monsters.name: Yuggothi Infiltrator
monsters.attacks: per weapon; arcane ranged weapons (2d6 radiant or aetheric)
monsters.feat: Eldritch artificer: brews potions and arcane inventions as a fifth-level dweomersmith. Enthralls mortals.
monsters.summary: Fungal crab-insect that enslaves a town.

monsters.name: Hound of Tindalos
monsters.attacks: unmaking bite (6d6 aetheric; critical if any die shows a 6)
monsters.feat: Two charge: tracks prey caught in a temporal paradox; teleports to prey. Immune to poison and critical hits.
monsters.summary: Spiked shadow hunting temporal trespassers.

monsters.name: Eye of Yog-Sothoth
monsters.attacks: bite (2d6 piercing), grab (reach), magic missile, elemental bolt (any) (5+ x2)
monsters.feat: Ten charge: any arcane spell by spending its circle; devour magic in a 5-pace cone.
monsters.summary: Sphere of eyes that unmakes magic.

monsters.name: Treant
monsters.feat: Hit locations; regenerates its body; sweep attack; Wood-aspected spells.
monsters.summary: Awakened tree; warden of its forest.

monsters.name: Ogre
monsters.attacks: unarmed strike (D6 blunt structure), earthbreaker maul (3D6+4 blunt structure)
monsters.feat: Hit locations; frenzy; sweep attack with rage; smells blood a mile away.
monsters.summary: Huge, blood-hungry goblin-orc.

monsters.name: Jötunn
monsters.attacks: unarmed strike (D6 structural bashing), ax or sword (2D6+5 structural slashing)
monsters.feat: Hit locations; elemental glamour and attacks; elemental armor.
monsters.summary: Titanic Fair Folk king of the elements.

monsters.name: Primordial Dragon
monsters.attacks: claws (2D6 sundering structural), bite (1D6+5 piercing structural), wing buffet (1d6 thunder structural), tail bash (1D6+5 blunt structural) (5+ x2)
monsters.feat: Hit locations; ten ichor: breath attacks (3D6+15 focused line); dragonscale.
monsters.summary: Fully grown primordial dragon with an elemental essence.

monsters.name: Tarrasque
monsters.attacks: stomp (5D6+10 blunt structure), bite (5D6+10 piercing structure) (5+)
monsters.feat: Legendary threat: hit by location and ranged damage; ten rage: roar, thrash, aetheric breath; regenerates.
monsters.summary: Island-sized dragon; the only one of its kind.

monsters.name: Redcap
monsters.abilities: Con +1, Str +0, Dex +1, Int +0, Wis +0, Cha -1
monsters.summary: Small goblin-orc; grows into a hobgoblin.

monsters.name: Hobgoblin
monsters.abilities: Con +2, Str +2, Dex +1, Int +0, Wis +0, Cha +0
monsters.summary: Medium goblin-orc.

monsters.name: Bugbear
monsters.abilities: Con +3, Str +3, Dex +1, Int +0, Wis +0, Cha +1
monsters.summary: Large goblin-orc.

monsters.name: Kobold
monsters.abilities: Con +0, Str +1, Dex +1, Int +0, Wis +0, Cha -1
monsters.summary: Small lizardfolk orc.

monsters.name: Troglodyte
monsters.abilities: Con +2, Str +2, Dex +1, Int +0, Wis +0, Cha +0
monsters.summary: Medium lizardfolk orc.

monsters.name: Dragonborn
monsters.abilities: Con +3, Str +3, Dex +1, Int +0, Wis +0, Cha +0
monsters.summary: Large lizardfolk orc, brewed into draconic form.

monsters.name: Serpentfolk
monsters.abilities: Con +0, Str +1, Dex +1, Int +0, Wis +2, Cha +0
monsters.summary: Dragon-serving serpent folk.
